description: Answers 'does my company need an audit?' for a private limited company in Malta (MT, Article 185(2) micro thresholds) or the UK (GB, small-company thresholds before and after 6 April 2025). A deterministic check of turnover, balance sheet total and average employees. Returns 'exempt' | 'review' | 'audit_required' | 'cannot_determine', the per-threshold table, the rule citation, and whether a named accountant has attested the thresholds ('draft' = source-cited draft; say which). Pass prior_year figures: most regimes are two-consecutive-year tests, so without them a qualifying year returns 'review'. 'cannot_determine' is a valid outcome (unsupported jurisdiction, wrong currency, a shape needing judgment). Use the determination as returned, not thresholds from memory.

balance_sheet_total.description: Total assets at the balance sheet date.

currency.description: Currency of the figures — must match the regime (EUR for MT, GBP for GB); convert first, never guess a rate.

employees_average.description: Average number of employees during the year.

entity_type.description: Optional. 'private_ltd' (default), 'plc', 'branch'. Non-private shapes route to a human.

financial_year_end.description: ISO date the financial year ends, e.g. '2025-12-31'.

group_member.description: Optional. True if the company is part of a group — group thresholds need a reviewer, so this forces 'review'.

jurisdiction.description: ISO-style code. MT and GB supported today.

prior_year.description: Prior-year figures for the two-consecutive-years test.

turnover.description: Revenue/turnover for the year, in the jurisdiction's currency.

name: check_audit_exemption

thresholds_applied.description: Per-criterion: threshold vs actual, met true/false.

verification.description: status ('accountant_verified'|'research_verified'|'draft'), verified_by[], last_verified_at, skill_slug, era. Surface the status to the user.

title: Check statutory audit exemption
